title: Simple to Manage by Leadership
desc: We make it extremely easy for management to assemble the ideal Widget Panel for their sales team. On our web portal managers can easily select customizable off-the-shelf Info-gathering widgets.

show_case.title: Select off-the-shelf Info-gathering Widgets
show_case.desc: Choose off-the-shelf info-gathering widget templates from our ever-growing Template Library.

show_case.title: Customize Your Own
show_case.desc: Modify texts, images, logos, documents, and page layout on the widget templates based on your needs.

show_case.title: Add to your Widget Panel
show_case.desc: Turn on and off widgets on the Panel and order them in the sequence you prefer.
